steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Romantic music prioritised emotional expression: chromatic harmony, rubato, wider dynamic range and thicker textures created intensity and drama. | Key Fact: Chopin's piano music uses rubato (flexible tempo), elaborate ornamentation and harmonic chromaticism — it demands expressive, personal interpretation. | Key Fact: The Romantic orchestra expanded significantly: more brass (trombones, tuba), more woodwind (piccolo, cor anglais, bass clarinet), harp and percussion. | Key Fact: Late Romantic Requiems (Verdi, Fauré) combined liturgical text with dramatic orchestration — sacred music with theatrical emotional power.
